title: Recovered or Memorized? Investigating Dynamical Consistency and Faithfulness in World Model Latents
abstract: arXiv:2611.18807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models develop internal simulators that can learn the structure and dynamics of an environment. It has been demonstrated that their internal representations are both meaningful and causal, but are these representations faithful to the governing dynamics of the environment they are learning? We introduce Anchored Recovery Certification (ARC), a procedure that utilizes a discrete Fr\'echet distance calculation with ground truth to evaluate dynamical consistency on candidate world models up to an affine gauge. We use the procedure on TD-MPC2 (decoder-free world model) that has learned the pendulum swing on an observation lift under varying hyperparameters at k = 5, 10, 25 steps. The model is then steered within a PCA-derived intervention subspace and compared against a ground-truth simulator using relative error to investigate dynamical faithfulness. translated_title: 恢复还是记忆？探究世界模型潜表示中的动力学一致性与忠实性
translated_abstract: 世界模型发展出能够学习环境结构与动力学的内部模拟器。已有研究表明，其内部表示既具有意义性又具有因果性，但这些表示是否忠实于其所学习环境的主导动力学？本文提出了锚定恢复认证（ARC），这是一种利用离散Fréchet距离与真值进行计算、在仿射规范（affine gauge）意义下评估候选世界模型动力学一致性的程序。作者将该程序应用于TD-MPC2（一种无解码器世界模型），该模型在不同超参数下于观测提升任务中学习了钟摆摆动，时间步长为k=5、10、25步。随后，模型在PCA导出的干预子空间内被引导，并与真值模拟器通过相对误差进行比较，以研究动力学忠实性。ARC充分性在k=10时对TD-MPC2的表现最为一致，七个常数中有六个（摘要内容在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出锚定恢复认证（ARC）方法，利用离散Fréchet距离在仿射规范下评估世界模型潜表示的动力学一致性，并通过PCA干预子空间检验其忠实性，发现TD-MPC2在k=10步时动力学一致性最为稳定。
